summary.text: Linda López is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 1997, representing District 11 in Bernalillo County.
López chairs the Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee and also sits on the Senate Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists López's occupation as consultant.
Between sessions, López is vice chair of the Legislative Health and Human Services Committee and a member of the Tobacco Settlement Revenue Oversight Committee.
